svg.title: Smart Notification Routing Engine AWS Resource Architecture
svg.desc: AWS resource architecture diagram using official AWS Architecture Icons.
svg.text: Smart Notification Routing Engine - AWS Resource Architecture
Official AWS-service view: organization-owned deployment, attention-aware routing, delivery feedback, analytics, and optional ML pipeline.
The adopter operates the infrastructure, data, delivery credentials, logs, and models in its own AWS account.
Static admin portal plus authenticated control-plane access
HTTP API routes invoke Java 21 Lambda services
Event stream, object storage, operational tables, audit trail
Optional adopter-operated feature engineering, training, and endpoint deployment
If SageMaker is unavailable, DecisionFn uses FALLBACK_HEURISTIC.
Cross-cutting controls used by all stacks
Cross-cutting services apply to all workloads without drawing per-resource lines
runtime request path: admin UI, API clients, API Gateway, Lambda services
durable data path: Kinesis, S3 buckets, DynamoDB operational/audit tables
delivery/ML orchestration: EventBridge, SES/SNS, Step Functions, SageMaker
Active channels shown: Amazon SES email and Amazon SNS SMS. ML endpoint is optional; fallback scoring keeps preview and scheduling usable.
AWS Architecture Icons are embedded in this SVG so the diagram can be opened or exported without separate asset files.
